entries.name: Fade
entries.recipe: Interpolate opacity between 0 and 1 without changing layout.

entries.name: Translate / Slide

entries.name: Scale
entries.recipe: Interpolate scale around a deliberate transform origin.

entries.name: Rotate
entries.recipe: Animate a bounded angle, then settle at the intended orientation.

entries.name: Skew
entries.recipe: Interpolate skewX; reserve distortion for short artwork or headings.

entries.name: Stretch
entries.recipe: Scale one axis while holding the other constant.

entries.name: Squash
entries.recipe: Compress Y and expand X briefly, then restore both axes.

entries.name: Pivot
entries.recipe: Set transform-origin to a corner and rotate through a short arc.

entries.name: Blur transition

entries.name: Color transition
entries.recipe: Interpolate background or stroke colors with readable contrast.

entries.name: Fade up
entries.recipe: Combine opacity 0 to 1 with translateY 30px to zero.

entries.name: Fade down
entries.recipe: Combine opacity with negative starting Y offset.

entries.name: Slide in left
entries.recipe: Translate a child from outside the left clip boundary.

entries.name: Slide in right
entries.recipe: Translate a child from outside the right clip boundary.

entries.name: Pop in
entries.recipe: Scale from near zero through a small overshoot to one.

entries.name: Grow from origin
entries.recipe: Scale from the lower-left origin instead of the center.

entries.name: Drop in
entries.recipe: Start above the frame and use a damped landing curve.

entries.name: Spring entrance
entries.recipe: Use a damped spring and a finite settle threshold.

entries.name: Overshoot entrance
entries.recipe: Pass the target once, then ease back to the final position.

entries.name: Zoom-through entrance
entries.recipe: Combine depth-like scale and focus while ending at identity.

entries.name: Fade away
entries.recipe: Decrease opacity and retain DOM until the exit completes.

entries.name: Shrink out
entries.recipe: Scale toward zero around the center during removal.

entries.name: Zoom out exit
entries.recipe: Scale down with a depth cue and fading contrast.

entries.name: Collapse exit
entries.recipe: Animate measured height or grid row size before removal.

entries.name: Slide out
entries.recipe: Translate beyond a clipping wrapper; preserve neighboring layout.

entries.name: Mask retract
entries.recipe: Animate inset from zero to a closed horizontal aperture.

entries.name: Dissolve
entries.recipe: Use a deterministic spatial threshold to remove image regions.

entries.name: Disintegration

entries.name: Fall off
entries.recipe: Combine downward acceleration and bounded rotation on a departing clone.

entries.name: Fly away
entries.recipe: Move a visual clone along an upward curved trajectory.

entries.name: Character stagger
entries.recipe: Segment text by grapheme and offset each character start time.

entries.name: Word stagger

entries.name: Line reveal

entries.name: Typewriter

entries.name: Text scramble

entries.name: Split-text assembly
entries.recipe: Move glyph fragments toward their measured final word positions.

entries.name: Text morph

entries.name: Kinetic typography

entries.name: Tracking animation

entries.name: Variable-font animation
entries.recipe: Animate supported font-variation axes; the demo illustrates weight with a stroke approximation.

entries.name: Outline drawing
entries.recipe: Convert a short display label to paths and draw normalized strokes.

entries.name: Text fill reveal
entries.recipe: Clip a moving color plane inside a static text mask.

entries.name: Moving gradient text

entries.name: Marquee

entries.name: Word carousel
entries.recipe: Transition one word at a time in a stable-width label container.

entries.name: Text on path
entries.recipe: Place glyphs along a curve with tangent-aligned orientation.

entries.name: Text bending
entries.recipe: Offset and rotate letters along a controllable baseline curve.

entries.name: Typographic echo
entries.recipe: Draw decorative copies with time-offset transforms and decreasing opacity.

entries.name: Odometer digits
entries.recipe: Use clipped vertical digit tracks for each changing place value.

entries.name: Reading highlight

entries.name: Image wipe

entries.name: Curtain reveal

entries.name: Ken Burns

entries.name: Image parallax

entries.name: Hover crossfade

entries.name: Displacement transition

entries.name: Liquid image transition
entries.recipe: Use a moving wave boundary to replace the old image.

entries.name: Image slicing
entries.recipe: Stagger translated image strips while preserving final registration.

entries.name: Image flip

entries.name: Pixel reveal
entries.recipe: Reveal a seeded grid of image tiles progressively.

entries.name: Rectangular reveal

entries.name: Circular reveal
entries.recipe: Increase circle radius until all corners are visible.

entries.name: Iris transition

entries.name: Polygon reveal

entries.name: Blob mask

entries.name: Diagonal wipe
entries.recipe: Sweep a diagonal polygon across the visual.

entries.name: Venetian blinds
entries.recipe: Expand parallel strip masks with synchronized or staggered timing.

entries.name: Checkerboard reveal

entries.name: Cursor-follow mask

entries.name: Radial sweep
entries.recipe: Expand a sector angle while keeping a constant outer radius.

entries.name: Line drawing
entries.recipe: Set pathLength to one and animate stroke-dashoffset from one to zero.

entries.name: Line erasing
entries.recipe: Animate the visible stroke length toward zero without altering geometry.

entries.name: Path tracer
entries.recipe: Evaluate position along the path as progress changes.

entries.name: Path morphing
entries.recipe: Interpolate equal-length compatible cubic path coordinate arrays.

entries.name: Icon morphing
entries.recipe: Morph compatible outlines or transition coordinated icon strokes.

entries.name: Dash flow
entries.recipe: Animate dash phase on a stationary path.

entries.name: Sequential vector reveal

entries.name: Brush-stroke reveal

entries.name: Line-to-interface

entries.name: Connector rerouting

entries.name: Scroll reveal

entries.name: Scroll scrubbing
entries.recipe: Map scroll position continuously into a bounded timeline value.

entries.name: Multilayer parallax

entries.name: Pinned scene

entries.name: Sticky storytelling

entries.name: Horizontal scroll section

entries.name: Scroll-controlled frame sequence

entries.name: Scroll zoom
entries.recipe: Map local scroll progress to a limited image scale.

entries.name: Scroll rotation

entries.name: Reading progression

entries.name: FLIP animation

entries.name: Animated grid reflow

entries.name: List reordering

entries.name: Shape interpolation

entries.name: Sliding navigation indicator

entries.name: Tab-content transition

entries.name: Responsive layout transition

entries.name: Page crossfade

entries.name: Push transition

entries.name: Slide-over transition

entries.name: Portal transition

entries.name: Zoom navigation

entries.name: Animated underline

entries.name: Skeleton shimmer

entries.name: Pendulum motion

entries.name: On leave viewport

entries.name: Scroll-linked

entries.name: Hover-triggered

entries.name: Click/tap-triggered

entries.name: Drag-controlled

entries.name: State-driven

entries.name: Audio/data-driven

entries.name: Linear
entries.recipe: Use p directly as the property interpolation value.

entries.name: Ease-in
entries.recipe: Use a convex easing curve, for example p cubed.

entries.name: Ease-out
entries.recipe: Use a concave easing curve, for example one minus the cube of one minus p.

entries.name: Ease-in-out

entries.name: Spring
entries.recipe: Use a damped oscillator or the host library spring with an explicit settle threshold.

entries.name: Bounce
entries.recipe: Use piecewise impact-like timing with decreasing rebound amplitude.

entries.name: Elastic
entries.recipe: Use a bounded oscillatory easing that ends at the target.

entries.name: Stagger
entries.recipe: Offset multiple element start times without duplicating business events.

entries.name: Yoyo / alternate
entries.recipe: Play the same timeline in alternating directions without resetting application state.

entries.name: Sequenced choreography
entries.recipe: Use a timeline with explicit phase boundaries and cancellation semantics.

groups.name: Foundations
groups.guidance: Transform, opacity, filter or color interpolation. Keep a stable wrapper and animate a child.

groups.name: Entrances
groups.guidance: Animate toward the natural visible layout; do not leave content hidden if JavaScript fails.

groups.name: Exits
groups.guidance: Keep the departing node until its exit finishes; move focus before removing an interactive region.

groups.name: Typography
groups.guidance: Preserve semantic text, grapheme clusters, Vietnamese accents and accessible reading order.

groups.name: Advanced type
groups.guidance: Treat decorative duplicates as aria-hidden. Provide a static readable label beneath the visual treatment.

groups.name: Images
groups.guidance: Crop inside an image wrapper. Keep aspect ratios and link hit areas fixed.

groups.name: Masks
groups.guidance: Animate clip/mask layers, not measured scroll-trigger containers or focus outlines.

groups.name: SVG paths
groups.guidance: Use normalized stroke length or compatible path topology; keep decorative paths outside reading text.

groups.name: Scroll
groups.guidance: Use native scrolling, stable measurements and bounded progress; do not hijack wheel or touch.

groups.name: Layout
groups.guidance: Measure before/after layout once; animate visual deltas without changing DOM identity or app data.

groups.name: Navigation
groups.guidance: Preserve navigation semantics and focus; clean up overlays and handle interrupted navigation.

groups.name: Controls
groups.guidance: An interaction must work immediately. Animation should confirm the action, not delay it.

groups.name: Feedback
groups.guidance: Only show actual loading/progress or an explicitly labeled illustration; never fake success.

groups.name: Physics
groups.guidance: Keep physics bounded and deterministic enough to settle; preserve keyboard alternatives.

groups.name: Pointer
groups.guidance: Provide touch/keyboard equivalents and avoid moving a hit target away from the pointer.

groups.name: Depth
groups.guidance: Use perspective, transforms or a real 3D renderer as appropriate. Canvas GIFs are 2D projection studies.

groups.name: Paper
groups.guidance: Restrict rotations/folds to artwork; real paragraphs, forms and controls remain upright.

groups.name: Particles
groups.guidance: Use bounded particle counts and deterministic seeds for testing. Keep decorative canvases out of the accessibility tree.

groups.name: Distortion
groups.guidance: These GIFs are Canvas 2D studies. Use shaders, mesh rendering or compositing when actual production fidelity needs them.

groups.name: Cinematic
groups.guidance: Let framing, focus or lighting serve a concrete transition. Avoid invented playback controls and telemetry.

groups.name: Data
groups.guidance: Derive values from actual data. GIF values are labeled demo; provide readable data alternatives in production.

groups.name: Product
groups.guidance: Use real app elements when the design calls for live UI; presentation must never mutate business state.

groups.name: Triggers
groups.guidance: The GIF simulates an input event; it cannot receive hover, focus or scroll. Implement the actual event in the host app.

groups.name: Timing
groups.guidance: This changes how another effect plays. Compose it with a visible property rather than calling it a separate visual effect.
